0022600031.text: The Timberwolves (6-3, third in the Northwest and seventh in the West, on a two-game winning streak) visit the Pelicans (4-4, fourth in the Southwest and 10th in the West, on a four-game winning streak) in Minnesota's 10th game of the season, an Emirates NBA Cup West Group B matchup. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, but Minnesota won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 132-126 win in Minneapolis on April 12. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (out, knee, surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles, surgery), and Terrence Shannon Jr. (day-to-day, hip bruise), while New Orleans is without Yves Missi (out, knee bruise) and Trey Murphy III (day-to-day, knee).
